title: PhD Computer Science
about: LUMS is accepting applications for its PhD Computer Science programme for Fall 2027. The online application closes on April 6, 2027 at 5:00 pm PKT, with supporting documents and the application fee due April 7, 2027.
requirements: LUMS Graduate Admission Test (LGAT) and SBASSE Subject Test, or GRE, by April 18, 2027 (per search results)
